doctrine: Files are evidence, not blobs. A case is the atomic unit of organization. Every file belongs to exactly one case. Workflows define every step — follow the workflow, never fail the task.

case_definition.case_terms: Cases use GO-25 terms. A case is an ENTITY with ATTRIBUTEs. Evidence items within a case have RELATIONSHIP edges. The case itself is the CONTAINS root for its evidence tree.

evidence_model.description: Every file ingested into the graph is EVIDENCE. Its path is its location_at_on_graph. Its hash is its identity. Its case membership is its meaning.

evidence_classes.primary_source: Original document, witness statement, direct observation — created at the time of events
evidence_classes.secondary_source: Analysis, report, summary — created after events from primary sources
evidence_classes.derived_artifact: Extraction, chunk, entity list — machine-generated from sources
evidence_classes.administrative: Receipt, log, manifest, workflow state — system-generated evidence of process
evidence_classes.reference: External document, law, standard — provides context but not case-specific

evidence_chain.description: Custody chain for every piece of evidence. No evidence moves without a receipt.

case_file_structure.description: How evidence files are organized within a case. Physical layout mirrors logical structure.

CASE-{YYYY}-{NNNNN}/.CASE_BRIEF.md: Human-readable case summary, status, key findings
CASE-{YYYY}-{NNNNN}/.case_manifest.json: Machine-readable case metadata — all evidence UUIDs, counts, status
CASE-{YYYY}-{NNNNN}/.LEADS/: Active leads, hunches, trails — items with LEADS_TO edges
CASE-{YYYY}-{NNNNN}/.CLAIMS/: Claims and hypotheses with EVIDENCE_FOR edges
CASE-{YYYY}-{NNNNN}/.ENTITIES/: Extracted entities — people, orgs, locations, accounts
CASE-{YYYY}-{NNNNN}/.TIMELINE/: Temporal ordering — events with PRECEDES/FOLLOWS/DURING edges
CASE-{YYYY}-{NNNNN}/.RECEIPTS/: All receipts for this case — one per operation
CASE-{YYYY}-{NNNNN}/.GRAPH/: Case-specific graph export — nodes and edges for this case only

step_1_collect.name: Evidence Collection
step_1_collect.description: New evidence arrives — file, screenshot, document, message, log, or witness statement.
step_1_collect.output: Evidence registered with UUID, SHA256, timestamp, collector ID

step_2_register.name: Evidence Registration
step_2_register.description: Register evidence in the system. Assign UUID, compute SHA256, record metadata.
step_2_register.output: Registered evidence with immutable hash and timestamp

step_3_hash.name: Cryptographic Hashing
step_3_hash.description: SHA256 hash computed and recorded. This is the evidence's immutable identity.
step_3_hash.output: Hashed evidence — identity is now immutable

step_4_ingest.name: Graph Ingestion
step_4_ingest.description: Evidence inserted into lucidota_go.graph_item as FILE_INGEST with staged status.
step_4_ingest.output: graph_item row with UUID, term=FILE_INGEST, status=staged, payload with hash+metadata
step_4_ingest.db_operation: INSERT INTO lucidota_go.graph_item (uuid, term, label, status, location_at_on_graph, payload, created_at) VALUES (...)

step_5_link_to_case.name: Case Linking
step_5_link_to_case.description: Link evidence to its parent case. Every evidence item belongs to a case.
step_5_link_to_case.output: BELONGS_TO edge: evidence → case. CONTAINS edge: case → evidence.
step_5_link_to_case.db_operation: INSERT INTO lucidota_go.graph_edge (source_uuid, target_uuid, edge_type, relationship_family, status, evidence_uuid) VALUES (evidence_uuid, case_uuid, 'BELONGS_TO', 'case_structure', 'current', null)

step_6_extract.name: Entity & Signal Extraction
step_6_extract.description: Extract entities, regex hits, temporal markers, and signals from evidence.
step_6_extract.output: Entity nodes, chunk nodes, edge connections back to source evidence

step_7_review.name: Evidence Review
step_7_review.description: Human or AI review of evidence. Classify, assess relevance, flag for promotion.
step_7_review.output: Reviewed evidence with classification, relevance score, promotion flag

step_8_promote.name: Graph Promotion
step_8_promote.description: Evidence is promoted through the graph promotion gate to canonical status.
step_8_promote.output: Promoted graph_item with status=approved, canonical_uuid set, operator_uuid set

step_9_challenge.name: Evidence Challenge
step_9_challenge.description: Evidence is challenged — contrary evidence found, chain of custody questioned, or new information contradicts.
step_9_challenge.input: New contradictory evidence or custody concern
step_9_challenge.output: CONTRADICTS edge from new evidence to challenged evidence

step_10_supersede.name: Evidence Supersession
step_10_supersede.description: Evidence is superseded by newer/better evidence. Old evidence is preserved, not deleted.
step_10_supersede.output: PRECEDES edge: old → new. Old evidence status → superseded.

workflow_invariants.no_orphan_evidence: Every evidence item (FILE_INGEST graph_item) MUST have a BELONGS_TO edge to a case within 1 hour of ingestion.
workflow_invariants.no_unhashed_evidence: Every evidence item MUST have a SHA256 hash recorded before ingestion.
workflow_invariants.no_unreceipted_mutation: Every state transition MUST produce a receipt in the case's RECEIPTS/ directory.
workflow_invariants.no_direct_canonical_write: Evidence ingestion writes via candidate_writer. Promotion writes via materializer through the promotion gate.
workflow_invariants.no_deletes_ever: Superseded evidence stays in the graph with status=superseded. Challenged evidence stays with status=challenged. Nothing is deleted.
workflow_invariants.case_closure_requires_completion: A case cannot be closed unless: (1) all evidence is linked, (2) all leads are resolved or marked dead_end, (3) all claims have EVIDENCE_FOR or CONTRADICTS edges, (4) the case manifest is up to date.

postgrest_big_board.description: Big Board surfaces case and evidence status via PostgREST API on lucidota_storage.

views_needed.case_summary: SELECT case_id, title, status, evidence_count, open_leads, last_activity FROM lucidota_go.case_summary_view
views_needed.evidence_status: SELECT status, count(*) FROM lucidota_go.graph_item WHERE term='FILE_INGEST' GROUP BY status
views_needed.orphan_evidence: SELECT gi.* FROM lucidota_go.graph_item gi LEFT JOIN lucidota_go.graph_edge ge ON gi.uuid = ge.source_uuid AND ge.edge_type = 'BELONGS_TO' WHERE gi.term = 'FILE_INGEST' AND ge.edge_uuid IS NULL
views_needed.promotion_queue: SELECT gi.* FROM lucidota_go.graph_item gi WHERE gi.term = 'FILE_INGEST' AND gi.status = 'reviewed' ORDER BY gi.created_at
